title: Spain accuses Trump ally Milei of ‘disgraceful’ election interference
summary_full: Argentinia's Javier Milei launched a barrage of insults at Spain’s left-wing Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on a visit to Madrid, calling on voters to oust him.
